# Frozen BSE active-offer source family

`receipts.json` records five exact detail responses and their independently
collected current-issue index. `.html.gz` files reproduce exact UTF-8 bytes,
including CRLF, without serving upstream scripts as executable pages.
`before.json` retains the five issuer baselines from main `5e8642f3`.
`rupee.gif.gz` is the reviewed currency marker named by the detail page.

Four index/detail pairs support provisional price band, market lot and minimum
bid quantity. Vivekanand has an empty detail response and conflicting historical
index prices; it is a rejection fixture, not an accepted zero/missing disclosure.
The independent source review is
`docs/reviews/2026-09-19-bse-active-offer-source-review.md`.

No bid lot, total amount, fresh/OFS split, minimum application money, final static
authority or source observation time is inferred from these pages.
